compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_marker.py` covering extended PR marker comment + ledger append after review.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: extended `DSO-Review-Cycle:` PR comment with findings tuples (idempotent).
- DD3: append cycle entry to cycle-ledger.json (atomic write).

## Specific failing test method names

1. `test_post_cycle_marker_creates_new_comment_when_absent` — PR_NUMBER=123, no existing marker for `(cycle_num=K, commit_sha=<sha>)` pair; mock gh CLI; assert CREATE call with body matching `DSO-Review-Cycle: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha> findings_hash=<h> tuples=<json>` (v1.1.0 format).
2. `test_post_cycle_marker_updates_existing_with_same_cycle_and_sha` — pre-seed PR comments with marker `DSO-Review-Cycle: cycle=2 commit_sha=abc...`; call `_post_cycle_marker_comment` with same (cycle_num=2, commit_sha='abc...'); assert UPDATE call (gh api PATCH /repos/.../issues/comments/<id>), NOT duplicate CREATE.
3. `test_post_cycle_marker_does_not_overwrite_marker_for_different_sha` — pre-seed marker for (cycle_num=1, commit_sha='old'); call with (cycle_num=1, commit_sha='new'); assert CREATE (different SHA → new comment), NOT overwrite (regression guard against marker corruption on SHA-reset).
4. `test_post_cycle_marker_skips_when_no_pr` — pr_number=None; assert no gh calls, function returns gracefully.
5. `test_append_cycle_called_after_review` — full main() with mocked dispatch returning findings; assert `cycle_ledger.append_cycle` called with positional args matching its actual signature: `(path, cycle_num, findings_tuples, commit_sha, findings_hash, halt_reason=None)`.
6. `test_findings_hash_determinism` — `_compute_findings_hash` called twice with the same tuples list (any input order) produces the same hash; assert sha256-derived 16-char hex format.

## Behavioral assertions

Mock `cycle_ledger.append_cycle`, `subprocess.run` (gh CLI), `async_dispatch_specialists`. Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (comment body literal substrings, ledger entry shape, hash determinism).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 6 test methods defined with the names above
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_marker.py -q --co | grep -E 'test_(post_cycle_marker|append_cycle|findings_hash)' | wc -l   # expect 6
- [ ] All 6 tests fail on current main (missing `_post_cycle_marker_comment`, `_compute_findings_hash`)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_marker.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAILED|ERROR)' | wc -l   # expect 6 or more
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_marker.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_marker.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_marker.py (new, ~200 lines)
